name: Ishmaiah
title: David's Warrior and Commander
summary: Ishmaiah was one of David's mighty warriors and a prominent figure among those who joined David in Ziklag. He was from Gibeon and was counted among the Thirty, indeed as leader over the Thirty. He was a skilled warrior who could use both his right and left hand with sling and bow.

keyEvents.title: Joined David in Ziklag
keyEvents.description: Ishmaiah was among the Benjaminite warriors who came to David in Ziklag while he was still hiding from Saul. He was the foremost among the Thirty.

keyEvents.title: Recognized as Leader Among the Thirty
keyEvents.description: Ishmaiah was counted as leader over the thirty mighty warriors who served David. He was known for his skill in battle.

keyEvents.title: Benjaminite Archers
keyEvents.description: Ishmaiah and his fellow soldiers from Benjamin were known for their ability to sling stones and shoot arrows with both right and left hands, making them especially valuable warriors.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's Growing Army
keyEvents.description: Ishmaiah's joining David was part of a larger movement in which warriors from various tribes left Saul and joined David, strengthening David's position before he became king.
